why: A's Theorem 3.27 assumes at every point of M tangent-germ data satisfying TangentGermChart.IsRegular: (a) delta sc-smooth on the whole of V (set sense), (b) the projection pi along Y maps the retract O into C. These are extra hypotheses the project adds because the text's proof fails without them (documented in TangentGerm.lean); B assumes only Definition 3.25 (delta an sc-infinity germ with k-dependent neighbourhoods, no condition on pi(O)), and B's clause (2) claims pi o phi is a chart for every datum, A only for regular data. A_to_B_of_allRegular (rt_check OK) proves B's conclusion from A's theorem_3_2_3_of_isRegular when every datum is regular, so this regularity is the whole gap; closing it would need new mathematics (re-graphing via the quadrant IFT, upgrading the germ smoothness), and whether B holds under the k-dependent germ reading is open. B => A fails because B needs X tame (A only needs tame retracts in the data), B's chart is only on some neighbourhood of the centre (A: d.chart on all of U0), and A's conjuncts theorem_3_2_3_degIndex and isScSmooth_subtype_val are outside B.
overlap: n/a (no direction proved); the diagnostic A_to_B_of_allRegular uses only the type of theorem_3_2_3_of_isRegular (A's other conjuncts mention theorem_3_2_3_isSubMPolyfold in their types, so any proof taking hA : A trips #rt_check)
